title: Constrained Max Drawdown: a Fast and Robust Portfolio Optimization Approach
key_result: MD LP 9.4% 3-mo OOS return / -3.3% max DD vs Markowitz 5.7% / -6.1%; MILP 200x faster; 2.8% covariance perturbation moved others 38-47% vs 3.7% constrained MD

title: Sizing the bets in a focused portfolio
key_result: Generalized multivariate Kelly FOC sum p_i k_ij/(1+sum f_j k_ij)=0 with long-only/leverage/max-alloc/permanent-loss constraints via 2^N_l Newton-Raphson enumeration; 5 identical 50/50 candidates: 35% unconstrained -> 2% with P=5%/K=50% loss constraint

title: Sizing the Risk: Kelly, VIX, and Hybrid Approaches in Put-Writing on Index Options
key_result: Hybrid Q_t=floor(PV_t/M_t * f*(p,a,b) * (1-P_rank(VIX_t,W))); 2024 nominal OOS 14-23% annualized; CAUTION: paper states in-sample 2018-2024 AND out-of-sample 2024 - windows overlap

title: Kelly Betting as Bayesian Model Evaluation: A Framework for Time-Updating Probabilistic Forecasts
key_result: Bankroll update w_i'=(p_i/m_i) sum m_i w_i; Kelly identifies correct model in 96.0% (faulty recency) vs log loss 73.1%; across 110 scenarios after 5 games Kelly wins 98/ties 1/loses 11

title: Bayesian Parametric Portfolio Policies
key_result: BPPP vs PPP OOS 1973-2023: Sharpe 1.32 vs 1.05, max DD -24.50% vs -37.21%, turnover 6.03 vs 9.54; Sharpe diff vs market 0.579, t=5.61, p<0.001; CE gain 142/184/255bp at gamma=2/5/10

title: Conformal Kelly: Conformal Prediction Intervals as the Scale in Fractional Kelly Position Sizing
key_result: f=0.15*mu_hat/sigma_hat^2 with 75% conformal intervals; DEV growth 0.2845 Sharpe 1.336; lockbox coverage 0.7450 vs 0.75 nominal but growth 0.0847/0.0701 vs naive 2x 0.1679 - registered claim partially refuted; ~200 DEV configs, cap bound 97.7% of days

title: How many independent bets are there?
key_result: SVD + Kaiser-Gutman (eigenvalues>=1): 41 JSE equities -> 8 dims, breadth ~3 vs naive sqrt(41)~6; equities+bonds -> 9 dims breadth 3; mixed universe -> 13 dims breadth ~4

title: Using Twitter to predict football outcomes
full_text: PDF via https://arxiv.org/pdf/1411.1243 (ar5iv HTML was abstract-only)
key_result: 1,975,614 tweets, EPL 2014-03-21 to 2014-05-11; Twitter-only RF 65.6% acc kappa 0.25; historical-only NB 58.9% kappa 0.239; combined RF 69.6% kappa 0.28; bigrams>unigrams, peak at 11-15 features/side

title: Sentiment Analysis of Twitter Data for Predicting Stock Market Movements
key_result: 250k MSFT tweets 2015-08-31 to 2016-08-25; sentiment RF 70.18% word2vec / 70.49% n-gram; 3-day aggregate sentiment -> next-day direction: logistic 69.01%, LibSVM 71.82%; single stock, split not stated time-ordered

title: Automatically Learning Construction Injury Precursors from Text
key_result: 90k+ incident reports; precursor mining via CNN receptive-field norms, gradient saliency |dCNN/da|, HAN attention; FOB injury_type CNN 95.49 F1, eye bodypart HAN 97.04 F1; TF-IDF+SVM beats DL except bodypart; WARNING: narratives contain outcome labels (leakage)

title: Trouble with the Curve: Predicting Future MLB Players Using Scouting Reports
key_result: ~10k scouting reports, debut-by-24 label (~7k usable, 80% negative); TextCNN 69.02% acc / 56.42% F1 best balanced; BCN 73.52% acc but 43.33% F1 (majority overfit); leakage study: 100% recall from prospect names alone without NLTK masking

title: Sentiment Correlation in Financial News Networks and Associated Market Movements
key_result: Reuters 2007-2013, 87 companies/9 sectors; Louvain on co-occurrence network -> 7 groups; sentiment shocks propagate to neighbors (asymmetric in financials); post-event CAR diverges, volatility elevates (Mann-Whitney p<0.01); associational not causal
